scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@aib-sitac/core && npm run build --workspace=@aib-sitac/api && npm run build --workspace=@aib-sitac/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@aib-sitac/core && npm run dev --workspace=@aib-sitac/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=@aib-sitac/core && npm run dev --workspace=@aib-sitac/web
scripts.dev:docker:db: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up db -d
scripts.dev:docker:api: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up db api --build --watch
scripts.dev:docker:api:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up db api --build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@aib-sitac/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aib-sitac/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@aib-sitac/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@aib-sitac/core && npm run test --workspace=@aib-sitac/api && npm run test --workspace=@aib-sitac/web
